text:
Conflict card for developer:

Input case is a pallet where fragile is true and automated_aisle is true.

Rule A says Fragile pallets require manual picking, so it calls for action manual_pick.

Rule B says An automated aisle requires robot picking, so it calls for action robot_pick.

manual_pick and robot_pick are incompatible actions for this same pallet.

Which rule wins for this input?
cost_basis: all terminal provider usage, persisted from first request
